items.title: BlackLock Ransomware Attacking Windows, Linux, and VMware ESXi Environments
items.description: A sophisticated new ransomware operation dubbed BlackLock has emerged as a significant threat to organizations worldwide, demonstrating advanced cross-platform capabilities and targeting diverse computing environments. Originally operating under the name “El Dorado” since March 2024, the group rebranded to BlackLock in September 2024, establishing itself as a formidable player in the ransomware…

items.title: Microsoft Patches Critical Entra ID Flaw Enabling Global Admin Impersonation Across Tenants
items.description: A critical token validation failure in Microsoft Entra ID (previously Azure Active Directory) could have allowed attackers to impersonate any user, including Global Administrators, across any tenant.
